office_does: The sheriff runs county law enforcement in Chelan County, including patrol, marine patrol, traffic, the drug task force and a behavioral health unit, and leads the response to wildfires, floods and other critical incidents.
race_blurb: First-term Sheriff Mike Morrison faces Stan Langlow, a patrol deputy in his own office who came from the Kitsap County Sheriff's Office; both prefer the Republican Party. Morrison took about 76% of the primary vote, and the race turns mainly on his record against Langlow's pitch for new leadership centered on deputy support and accountability.

candidates.summary: Incumbent sheriff, first elected in 2022, with more than 20 years in law enforcement, running on staffing, training, equipment, grant funding and incident response.
highlights: Says the Marine Patrol, Traffic Unit, Drug Task Force and Behavioral Health Unit have become more visible, proactive and effective under his leadership [S1]
Announced $713,000 in federal funding for less-lethal and de-escalation tools, after $660,000 for body-worn cameras in 2024 [S7]
Called Flock camera technology 'outstanding' but said the company has damaged its relationship with Chelan County residents [S8]
Won the August primary with 75.94% of the vote [S5]

experience.basis: Incumbent sheriff since the 2022 election with 20+ years in law enforcement and a seat on the WASPC executive board, running on his record.

safety.basis: Emphasizes staffing and 'visible, proactive' enforcement units, alongside a behavioral health unit and de-escalation tools; no diversion or non-police-response proposals.

candidates.summary: Chelan County patrol deputy and former Kitsap County patrol and training sergeant and SWAT assistant commander, running on leadership, deputy support and community connection.
highlights: About 10 years in law enforcement, most of it at the Kitsap County Sheriff's Office [S1][S3]
Wants an office that is 'accountable, results-driven, and honest about its performance' with measurable outcomes [S4]
Would give frontline deputies 'real pathways for input' and invest in training beyond minimum requirements [S4]
Promises 'fiscal responsibility' and 'value and accountability to taxpayers' [S3]

experience.basis: Deputy with about a decade in law enforcement, never elected to public office, recently hired by the office and challenging his own sheriff.

spending.basis: Pitches fiscal responsibility, measurable performance outcomes and value and accountability to taxpayers; general statements, no specific budget proposals.
